product.document_type: Supplier PURITY base-oils brochure / typical properties

chemistry.value: Hydrotreated/hydrocracked paraffinic and cycloparaffinic mineral hydrocarbons
chemistry.printed_text: HT Purity Process: severe hydrotreating/hydrocracking, dewaxing and hydrofinishing

open_questions: Not verified (2026-10 audit): the grade-level brochure cited for API Group II could not be retrieved; the field is Missing (see the API Group question). Previous note: 'API Group II verified from Petro-Canada's official World-Class Base Oils brochure; the original 2015 brochure did not explicitly classify L60.'
Sulfur, Noack, saturates, aromatics and CCS are not reported for L60 in the cited brochure.
Grade-specific SDS and other brochure editions require reconciliation.

API Group (2026-10 audit): previously recorded as 'Group II' (Reported) citing Petro-Canada's ILMA Engage base-oils brochure (https://petrocanadalubricants.com/-/media/pdfs/brochures/base-oils/ilma-engage-sponsorship-base-oils-brochure.ashx, no page), printed_text 'PURITY L60 listed in GROUP II TYPICAL PROPERTIES table'. That brochure could not be retrieved (Petro-Canada blocks automated access; no Wayback Machine copy; the distributor-hosted 'World-Class Base Oils' copy is also blocked), so no grade-level classification of PURITY L60 could be inspected. Petro-Canada's LUB3213E editions (2015.07 = DL2-10020.pdf p.1; 2023.03 p.1) describe PURITY only as 'Group II and Group II+ base oils' at brand level, which does not classify an individual grade; the field is now Missing. Obtain the brochure or a grade-specific Petro-Canada document to confirm.
